summary: Shengfeng Development Limited, a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its 2026 extraordinary general meeting held August 25, 2026. Shareholders approved a 15-for-1 share consolidation of Class A and Class B ordinary shares, effective September 4, 2026, contingent on Nasdaq acceptance; amended authorized share capital accordingly; and adopted amended and restated memorandum and articles of association. All three resolutions passed with overwhelming majorities (approximately 419 million votes for each). The consolidation adjusts par value from US$0.0001 to US$0.0015 per share, with fractional shares rounded up. This is a routine corporate governance and capital-structure filing, not a special situation.
